title: Site settings
subtitle: Support authority level, connection and monitoring preferences

error.saveAuthority: Not saved — the authority level was not applied.

authority.title: Support authority level
authority.hint: Decide how much freedom support has. Sensitive actions need your approval at every level.

report.title: Report only
report.desc: Observe and suggest only; nothing is changed.

confirm.title: With approval
confirm.desc: Prepares the fix and waits for your approval.

auto.title: Automatic
auto.desc: Handles low-risk work on its own; sensitive actions still need approval.

sensitive.title: Actions that always need approval
sensitive.hint: These are never done without your permission, even in automatic mode.

policy.title: Automatic updates
policy.notPushed: Saved, but not yet applied to the site — it will be retried on the next check.

run.none: No automatic update report has been recorded from the site yet; until the first run, pending updates are not measured.
run.unknown_one: The outcome of {count} item is unknown — recorded as neither succeeded nor failed.
run.unknown_other: The outcome of {count} items is unknown — recorded as neither succeeded nor failed.
run.allOk: Last automatic update report: {counts} — all completed successfully.
run.allOkWhen: Last automatic update report ({when}): {counts} — all completed successfully.
